newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BT Securities starts chemical cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BT Securities starts chemical cos.

text.p: -- BT Securities said it initiated coverage of several specialty chemical companies.
-- said it initiated coverage of International Specialty Products Inc with a buy rating and set a 12-month price target of $15-$16 a share.
-- expects International Specialty to earn $0.83 a share in 1996 and $0.95 a share in 1997.
-- also initiated coverage of Albemarle Corp with a market perform rating and set a 12-month price target of $22 a share.
-- said expects "sub-par" earnings performance from Albemarle through the first half of 1997.
-- said it initiated coverage of Cytec Industries Inc with a buy rating and set a 12-month price target of $50 a share. Expects the company to earn $1.95 a share in 1996 and $2.30 a share in 1997.
-- said Cytec's top-line growth is accelerating and will reach eight percent for several years.
